summary: Scope review for iteration `feedback-request-batch-upload` succeeded. The current stories, elaborated requirements, and test design are consistent with the delivery objective: protected Feedback Request Excel upload, validation for `email`, `type`, `product_code`, `product_name`, and `purchase_date`, support for `type=purchase` only, traceable feedback batch and feedback rows, unique feedback-link identifiers, mockable Gmail request email delivery, delivery status tracking, and approved non-browser verification. Scope is properly bounded away from the public customer feedback form, rating/message submission, Configure implementation, registration/profile changes, welcome-email behavior changes except reusable patterns, browser execution, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email/customer contact. Technical readiness is acceptable: prerequisite `authenticated-dashboard-shell` is present with protected dashboard routing and a protected Feedback Request placeholder; Prisma currently lacks FeedbackBatch/Feedback models and package dependencies currently lack an Excel parser, but both are expected delivery work rather than scope blockers. Checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. `npm.cmd ls nodemailer @types/nodemailer xlsx exceljs zod --depth=0` returned an empty tree with exit code 1, confirming those dependencies are not installed yet; this remains expected implementation work. Browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email sending were not run per task constraints.
